beast_claw: Beast Claw (Thú Trảo): A heavy beast paw print with four toes and claws, pressed deep into mud
swift_hound: Swift Hound (Tấn Khuyển): A lean hound in mid-leap with ears back, legs stretched out in a full gallop
beast_den: Beast Den (Thú Huyệt): A dark cave mouth ringed with bones and fur tufts and two glowing eyes watching from inside
gourd_neck: Gourd Neck (Hồ Lô Cảnh): The narrow neck of a gourd, cinched like an hourglass waist with a little knot of cord around it
elixir_store: Elixir Store (Dược Tàng): A wooden shelf with several small gourd bottles and stoppers lined up, different sizes
vine_gourd: Vine Gourd (Đằng Hồ Lô): A gourd growing on a curling vine with tendrils and a small leaf, plump and green
sealed_stopper: Sealed Stopper (Tắc Khẩu): A gourd mouth sealed with a carved wooden stopper tied by cord, with a talisman strip of plain paper
gourd_of_ten_thousand_years: Gourd of Ten Thousand Years (Vạn Niên Hồ Lô): A large golden gourd floating above mist and clouds, its mouth open spilling a thin stream of spirit light
calabash_spirit: Calabash Spirit (Hồ Lô Tinh): A little living gourd with a sleeping face and tiny arms, sitting on a lotus leaf
ten_thousand_years: Ten Thousand Years (Vạn Niên): An enormous ancient gourd-vine with gnarled trunk-thick stems, aged by countless rings of time
spirit_lantern: Spirit Lantern (Linh Đăng): A hanging paper lantern shaped like a beast head with a glowing flame within, tassels dangling
totem_pole: Totem Pole (Đồ Đằng Trụ): A tall carved wooden totem pole stacked with beast heads of wolf, bear and eagle, tapering upward
carved_faces: Carved Faces (Khắc Diện): A flat wooden mask carved with a fierce beast face, tusks and horns, with a ring of leaves around
ancestor_beast: Ancestor Beast (Tổ Thú): A huge ancient horned beast statue seated with a stone-like hide and mossy shoulders, stately and calm
beast_soul_totem: Beast-Soul Totem (Thú Hồn Đồ Đằng): A circular totem stone engraved with a coiled beast and a glowing paw print in its centre
pack_howl: Pack Howl (Lang Hống): A wolf head thrown back in a howl with echoing sound-ring curves around its muzzle
wolf_king: Wolf King (Lang Vương): A large wolf with a thick mane and a crown-like crest of antlers standing proudly, head high
running_wolves: Running Wolves (Bôn Lang): Two wolves running in profile one behind the other, legs outstretched with dust trailing
hunting_ground: Hunting Ground (Liệp Trường): A wolf paw-print trail crossing a clearing toward a lone tree with a single feather on the ground
howling_at_the_moon: Howling at the Moon (Khiếu Nguyệt): A wolf silhouette on a rock howling at a big round moon with a ring of thin cloud
wolf_pack: Wolf Pack (Lang Quần): A cluster of three wolves standing close, their heads turned in different directions with the leader forward
